acceptance: kill_group, after verifying the group and before its first signal, reads ps -A -o pid=,ppid=,pgid=,lstart= once (lstart parsed as the rest of the line, compared as start_token compares it) and records every transitive descendant (by parent pid) of the group's members that is outside the group, with its start time

After the group is gone, each recorded descendant still alive with the same start time gets SIGTERM, then SIGKILL after the grace; a pid authoritatively absent or whose start time differs is gone and never signalled; a survivor, or a failed, timed-out or unparsable descendant inventory or recheck, raises WorkerError naming the pid or the failure (the group itself is still signalled as today), so terminate does not report terminated

acceptance: When final_answer turns a non-chore run's answer into a rerun request (no JSON object, a fenced object, text after the object, or an object failing the output schema) and the last attempt exited 0 with no capacity reason, review delegate runs M21.35's one repair phase with the parse reason in place of the refusal text; a capacity failure, a harness non-zero exit, a review failure (a write) and a chore reviewer still get no repair turn

Same limit and RUN fields: run['refusal'] holds the parse reason, the repair attempts are marked repair: true, a second failure of either kind (parse or review record refusal) leaves the run incomplete, exit 1, with a reason naming both and no third turn; --resume of an incomplete run with a stored parse reason sends the repair pair, not RESUME_PROMPT. repair_prompt introduces a parse reason as specy-road's reading of the final message (not review record's output) and asks for the whole JSON object as the final message with no fence and nothing after it; the refusal wording is unchanged

Tests in tests/test_review_delegate_repair.py: fenced JSON, prose after the object, and no JSON at all, each followed by a valid answer -> filed after one repair turn whose prompt contains the parse reason; parse failure twice -> incomplete naming both; parse failure then a refusal -> incomplete, no third turn; capacity error with no answer and a non-zero harness exit -> no repair turn; --resume with a stored parse reason -> repair pair. The no-json case leaves test_no_repair_turn_unless_review_record_refused (renamed for its remaining cases). docs/orchestration-reviewer-output.md repair bullet and CHANGELOG [Unreleased] Fixed
